The main takeaway from our work is that
the endoreplication pathway is a target for regulation by auxin, and that the endoreplicating cells in the hypocotyl are an essential source of growth in this organ.
the ABCB19‐mediated auxin pathway is required for a component of the endocycle in Arabidopsis.
